On Saturday, July 9, 2016, GEYK held the Bee Project with Mullae Youth Center and Green Asia. It was a warm gathering of teenagers and young adults working to protect bees. Thank you to everyone who made the trip to Mullae Youth Center despite the heat!

Song Kwon-il, the head of Bees City, explained why bees are so important to crop production and how climate change threatens them. GEYK team lead Kim Ji-yoon spoke about what climate change is and how it affects us. After the talks, we went outside together to plant wildflowers.
